scoring_contract.preview_semantics: Current-snapshot estimates use the official public formula but cannot know unreleased future slot weather. Authoritative scores are computed by segmented replay.

weather_score_interface.formula: score: H(is_observable) * instrument_efficiency * transparency * sky_quality / (seeing_arcsec * airmass); program bands use the same quality without instrument_efficiency
